rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when access or eligibility is restricted to a specified group or condition.

example.jyutping: zi2 haan6 wui2 jyun4 jap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this for a product, service, or benefit reserved for a particular member group or person.

example.english: This is an exclusive perk for members.
example.traditional: 呢個係會員專屬嘅優惠。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 wui2 jyun4 zyun1 suk6 ge3 jau1 wai6

rows.note: Use this before a noun such as 注意力 when exclusive means whole or undivided.

example.english: I gave the report my exclusive attention.
example.traditional: 我將全部注意力放晒喺份報告度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 cyun4 bou6 zyu3 ji3 lik6 fong3 saai3 hai2 fan6 bou3 gou3 dou6

rows.meaning: going out only with each other
rows.note: Use this for someone who is romantically committed to only one partner.

example.english: I’m exclusive with you and won’t date anyone else.
example.traditional: 我對你係專一㗎，唔會再同其他人拍拖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 nei5 hai6 zyun1 jat1 gaa3 m4 wui5 zoi3 tung4 kei4 taa1 jan4 paak3 to1
